title: 第6章 她又被抛弃了吗？
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“李队，孩子们都已经认领得差不多了。

剩下的几个父母在外地，明天才能来。”

李安国点头。

视线扫过剩下几名孩子的脸。

“念念呢？”

任曼妮从记录本上抬头。

“念念不是在这……咦？”

座位上空空如也。

任曼妮快步走出警局，又到警局后面的值班室看了看。

厕所也没有。

门岗大爷见任曼妮神情着急，来来回回的跑。

探出头问到：“妮子，你是不是在找那个小孩？”

“对！她叫念念，大爷你看到她了吗？”

门岗大爷点头。

“看到了，刚刚来了个人把她接走了。”

“接走了？”任曼妮拧眉。

念念从小在福利院长大。

福利院倒闭后，她就跟着收破烂的爷爷一起生活。

难道是爷爷来了？

门岗大爷听到任曼妮嘀咕什么爷爷不爷爷的。

连忙解释，“是个女的，大概三十来岁，和念念认识，好像说什么拆迁，然后那丫头就跑了。”

任曼妮听得云里雾里，脑袋更晕了。

念念只有个爷爷相依为命，哪来的什么女人。

她调出监控。

确实和门岗大爷说的一样。

念念和那女人认识。

那女人好像还是专门来找她的。

不过监控隔得太远。

听不清两人说了什么。

“曼妮，你去废品站看看……算了，我去吧！”

李安国话说到一半，突然改变主意。

那丫头帮了他们这么大忙。

他应该亲自过去感谢一下。

李安国将警局的事情交代好。

买了些水果和小孩子爱吃的零食，取了一千块钱，直奔废品收购站。

只是到达目的地后。

发现废品收购站变成了一个建筑工地？

他又往前开了一百米。

导航立马提示掉头。

来来回回跑了几趟。

李安国很是疑惑的下了车。

“您好，请问这附近是不是有个废品收购站？”

工头摆手，“什么废品收购站？不知道，你去别处问问吧！”

“工头，不好了！”

一名工人急匆匆跑来，看了眼李安国，小声附在工头耳边嘀咕了几句。

工头脸色骤变。

Page (1/3)

“Team Li, the children have almost claimed their names.

The remaining parents are out of town and won't be able to come until tomorrow."

Li Anguo nodded.

His eyes swept over the faces of the remaining children.

"Where is Nian Nian?"

Ren Manni looked up from the record book.

"Nian Nian isn't here... Huh?"

The seats were empty.

Ren Manni walked out of the police station quickly and went to the duty room behind the police station to take a look.

There is no toilet either.

Uncle Mengang saw Ren Manni looking anxious and running back and forth.

He stuck his head out and asked: "Nizi, are you looking for that child?"

"Yes! Her name is Niannian, sir, have you seen her?"

Uncle Mengang nodded.

"I saw it. Someone just came to pick her up."

"Took it?" Ren Manni frowned.

Niannian grew up in an orphanage.

After the orphanage closed down, she lived with her grandfather who collected rags.

Could it be that grandpa is here?

Uncle Mengang heard Ren Manni muttering about being a grandpa and not being a grandpa.

He quickly explained, "It's a woman, about thirty years old. She knows Niannian. She seemed to say something about demolition, and then the girl ran away."

Ren Manni was confused and dizzy after hearing this.

Niannian only has a grandfather to depend on, so where does the woman come from?

She called up the surveillance.

It is indeed the same as what Uncle Mengang said.

Nian Nian knows that woman.

The woman seemed to have come specifically to see her.

But the monitoring is too far apart.

It was unclear what the two said.

"Mannie, go to the scrap station and take a look...forget it, I'll go!"

In the middle of speaking, Li Anguo suddenly changed his mind.

That girl helped them so much.

He should go over and thank him in person.

Li Anguo explained the matters at the police station.

I bought some fruits and snacks that children love to eat, withdrew a thousand yuan and went straight to the scrap collection station.

Just after arriving at your destination.

Found the scrapyard turned into a construction site?

He drove another hundred meters.

The navigation immediately prompted a U-turn.

I ran back and forth several times.

Li Anguo got out of the car very confused.

"Hello, is there a scrap collection station near here?"

The foreman waved his hand, "What kind of scrap collection station? I don't know, go and ask elsewhere!"

"Foreman, it's bad!"

A worker hurried over, glanced at Li Anguo, and whispered a few words in the foreman's ear.

The foreman's expression suddenly changed.
